meanings.en: not conscious of or paying attention to something
meanings.exampleEn: He rushed ahead, unmindful of the danger.
meanings.exampleTr: Tehlikeyi hiç dikkate almadan öne atıldı.

meanings.en: lacking enthusiasm or a reason to do something
meanings.exampleEn: The students seemed unmotivated and bored during the lesson.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrenciler ders boyunca isteksiz ve sıkılmış görünüyordu.

meanings.en: not seen or noticed
meanings.exampleEn: She slipped out of the room unnoticed.
meanings.exampleTr: Odadan fark edilmeden sıvıştı.

meanings.en: not quick to notice things around you
meanings.exampleEn: He was so unobservant that he never saw the changes in the office.
meanings.exampleTr: O kadar dikkatsizdi ki ofisteki değişiklikleri hiç fark etmedi.

meanings.en: not new or interesting; copied from something else
meanings.exampleEn: The critics dismissed the film as dull and unoriginal.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştirmenler filmi sıkıcı ve özgünlükten uzak bularak eleştirdi.

meanings.en: different from what is usual or accepted
meanings.exampleEn: She used unorthodox methods to solve the problem.
meanings.exampleTr: Sorunu çözmek için alışılmadık yöntemler kullandı.

meanings.en: having no equal; better or greater than any other
meanings.exampleEn: The company enjoyed unparalleled success last year.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket geçen yıl eşsiz bir başarı yakaladı.

meanings.en: the state of not being liked by many people
meanings.exampleEn: The policy's unpopularness was clear from the angry protests.
meanings.exampleTr: Politikanın sevilmezliği öfkeli protestolardan belliydi.

meanings.en: in a way that cannot be foreseen or expected
meanings.exampleEn: The stock market behaved unpredictably all week.
meanings.exampleTr: Borsa hafta boyunca öngörülemez biçimde hareket etti.

meanings.en: not influenced by unfair opinions; fair and impartial
meanings.exampleEn: A judge must give an unprejudiced ruling based on the facts.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir yargıç, gerçeklere dayalı önyargısız bir karar vermelidir.

meanings.en: the state of not being ready for something
meanings.exampleEn: The disaster exposed the city's total unpreparedness.
meanings.exampleTr: Felaket, kentin tam bir hazırlıksızlık içinde olduğunu ortaya çıkardı.

meanings.en: not trying to appear more important or impressive than you are
meanings.exampleEn: Despite his fame, he lived in an unpretentious little house.
meanings.exampleTr: Ününe rağmen gösterişsiz küçük bir evde yaşıyordu.

meanings.en: the quality of not trying to seem more important than you are
meanings.exampleEn: People admired the unpretentiousness of her lifestyle.
meanings.exampleTr: İnsanlar onun yaşam tarzındaki gösterişsizliğe hayrandı.

meanings.en: seeming unlikely to be successful or good
meanings.exampleEn: The project had an unpromising start but eventually thrived.
meanings.exampleTr: Proje umut vermeyen bir başlangıç yaptı ama sonunda başarıya ulaştı.

meanings.en: not kept safe from harm or danger
meanings.exampleEn: The unprotected coastline is vulnerable to storms.
meanings.exampleTr: Korunmasız kıyı şeridi fırtınalara karşı savunmasız.

meanings.en: the state of being impossible to reach or contact
meanings.exampleEn: The server's unreachability caused delays across the network.
meanings.exampleTr: Sunucunun erişilemezliği ağ genelinde gecikmelere yol açtı.

meanings.en: not prepared or ready for something
meanings.exampleEn: The team was unready for the sudden change in plans.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekip, planlardaki ani değişikliğe hazır değildi.

meanings.en: not identified, acknowledged, or given proper credit
meanings.exampleEn: Her contribution went unrecognized for many years.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun katkısı uzun yıllar boyunca takdir edilmedi.

meanings.en: not made pure by an industrial process; in a natural state
meanings.exampleEn: Unrefined sugar retains more of its natural minerals.
meanings.exampleTr: İşlenmemiş şeker doğal minerallerinin çoğunu korur.

meanings.en: lacking good manners or sophistication
meanings.exampleEn: His unrefined manners embarrassed his hosts.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaba tavırları ev sahiplerini utandırdı.

meanings.en: the quality of not being able to be trusted or depended on
meanings.exampleEn: The unreliability of the old machines slowed production.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski makinelerin güvenilmezliği üretimi yavaşlattı.

meanings.en: not feeling sorry about something you have done
meanings.exampleEn: The thief remained unrepentant throughout the trial.
meanings.exampleTr: Hırsız, dava boyunca hiç pişmanlık duymadı.

meanings.en: not reacting or replying to something
meanings.exampleEn: The patient was unresponsive when the doctors arrived.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktorlar geldiğinde hasta tepki vermiyordu.

meanings.en: not limited or controlled in any way
meanings.exampleEn: Members have unrestricted access to all the facilities.
meanings.exampleTr: Üyeler tüm tesislere kısıtlamasız erişebilir.

meanings.tr: tatmin etmeyen, karşılığını vermeyen, doyurucu olmayan
meanings.en: not giving satisfaction or a worthwhile result for your effort
meanings.exampleEn: She found the job tedious and unrewarding.
meanings.exampleTr: İşi sıkıcı ve tatmin etmeyen buldu.

meanings.tr: yetersiz biçimde, tatmin edici olmayan şekilde
meanings.en: in a way that is not good enough for a particular purpose
meanings.exampleEn: The problem was resolved unsatisfactorily and later returned.
meanings.exampleTr: Sorun yetersiz biçimde çözüldü ve sonradan yeniden ortaya çıktı.

meanings.en: not making you feel pleased or content
meanings.exampleEn: The ending of the movie was disappointing and unsatisfying.
meanings.exampleTr: Filmin sonu hayal kırıklığı yaratan ve tatmin etmeyen bir sondu.

meanings.en: not showing the careful and serious approach expected in academic work
meanings.exampleEn: Reviewers criticized the article as sloppy and unscholarly.
meanings.exampleTr: Hakemler makaleyi özensiz ve bilimsel olmayan bulup eleştirdi.

meanings.en: looking at something without noticing or paying attention to it
meanings.exampleEn: She stared with unseeing eyes at the wall ahead.
meanings.exampleTr: Önündeki duvara boş boş, görmeden bakıyordu.

meanings.en: not influenced by emotions; practical and realistic
meanings.exampleEn: She gave an unsentimental account of the difficult years.
meanings.exampleTr: Zor yılları duygusallıktan uzak, gerçekçi bir dille anlattı.

meanings.en: the quality of being unpleasant to look at
meanings.exampleEn: Residents complained about the unsightliness of the abandoned factory.
meanings.exampleTr: Sakinler terk edilmiş fabrikanın çirkinliğinden şikâyet etti.

meanings.en: not stated or named clearly
meanings.exampleEn: The meeting was postponed for an unspecified period.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantı belirtilmemiş bir süreliğine ertelendi.

meanings.en: understood or felt without being said in words
meanings.exampleEn: There was an unspoken agreement between them.
meanings.exampleTr: Aralarında söylenmemiş bir anlaşma vardı.

meanings.en: the state of not being firm, stable, or in balance
meanings.exampleEn: The unsteadiness of his hands made writing difficult.
meanings.exampleTr: Ellerindeki titreme yazı yazmayı zorlaştırıyordu.

meanings.en: to remove yourself from a mailing list or subscription service
meanings.exampleEn: Click here to unsubscribe from our newsletter.
meanings.exampleTr: Bültenimizden çıkmak için buraya tıklayın.

meanings.en: not supported or proven by evidence
meanings.exampleEn: The report was based on unsubstantiated rumors.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor asılsız söylentilere dayanıyordu.

meanings.en: in a way that is expected and causes no surprise
meanings.exampleEn: Unsurprisingly, the team won again.
meanings.exampleTr: Beklendiği gibi, takım yine kazandı.

meanings.en: not aware that something bad is about to happen
meanings.exampleEn: The scammers targeted unsuspecting elderly people.
meanings.exampleTr: Dolandırıcılar hiçbir şeyden habersiz yaşlı insanları hedef aldı.

meanings.en: impossible to defend against criticism or to continue
meanings.exampleEn: His position became untenable after the scandal.
meanings.exampleTr: Skandaldan sonra konumu savunulamaz hâle geldi.

meanings.en: not yet proved by experience or examination
meanings.exampleEn: The new treatment is still largely untested.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni tedavi hâlâ büyük ölçüde denenmemiş durumda.

meanings.en: up to the point in time when something happens
meanings.exampleEn: The shop is open until nine o'clock.
meanings.exampleTr: Dükkân saat dokuza kadar açık.

meanings.en: up to the time that something occurs
meanings.exampleEn: Wait here until I come back.
meanings.exampleTr: Ben dönene kadar burada bekle.

meanings.en: to (an archaic or literary form of 'to')
meanings.exampleEn: Do unto others as you would have them do unto you.
meanings.exampleTr: Başkalarına, sana davranılmasını istediğin gibi davran.

meanings.en: unable to be affected, harmed, punished, or matched
meanings.exampleEn: With such powerful friends, he seemed untouchable.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kadar güçlü dostları olunca dokunulmaz görünüyordu.

meanings.en: not handled, changed, or affected by something
meanings.exampleEn: The remote valley remained untouched by tourism.
meanings.exampleTr: Ücra vadi turizmden etkilenmeden el değmemiş kaldı.

meanings.en: not taught the skills needed for a particular job or activity
meanings.exampleEn: To the untrained eye, the two paintings look identical.
meanings.exampleTr: Eğitimsiz bir göze iki tablo birbirinin aynısı görünüyor.
